## Ruling check and disposition (2026-10-22)

Choice: `none`. Stop work under the cited reference: ADR 0014 is no longer
in force. This does not select an off schedule for the report job.

Read the cited file from `example/mira-decisions` at commit
`6ca078bb848966bf9e398d75717e384c533a41bd`. Its computed byte digest is
`sha256:d3d544af6856343e2f377ea805270fab5e554cf4beb05a348213efce6b3f1993`,
which matches the reference. It was Accepted at that commit.

At the decision repository's current HEAD,
`1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c`, ADR 0014 is marked
`Superseded by 0023`. ADR 0023 is Accepted and replaces 06:00 with 07:00
shop time while retaining daily cadence; ADR 0002's weekly cadence also
remains superseded.

Before resuming implementation, refresh the task's ruling reference to the
in-force successor and recheck its status:

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions (local clone: ../mira-decisions)
  ADR            0023
  Path           docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366

This session is decision and documentation only, as requested. No feature
implementation, commits, pushes, or merges. `src/report_job.js` still uses
`weekly`; it is not evidence of the current business ruling.
